candidate.title: CAP-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of CXXC affinity purification plus deep sequencing (CAP-seq): preassembled CXXC on nickel-charged sepharose captures unmethylated-CpG-rich DNA, which is eluted and supplies DNA for the named deep-sequencing readout. The associated Illingworth implementation resolves the DNA substrate and pre-CAP sequencing-adaptor interface. No alternative target workflow is depicted; the catalogue RNA description and recommended library-prep kits do not add target methods.

states.label: Genomic DNA fragments presented for CAP
features: The schematic depicts blue DNA with red methylated CpG and green unmethylated CpG symbols; the CpG island icon supplies the biological target context.

In the associated Illingworth implementation, CAP input DNA already bears Solexa sequencing adaptors before affinity purification. Adapter structures, strand polarity and specific terminal chemical groups are not drawn.

operations.label: Hybridize to sepharose column
operations.description: Contact the input DNA with the preassembled CXXC-sepharose matrix. DNA containing suitable unmethylated CpG clusters becomes associated with the solid support, producing the retained DNA-matrix complex. The diagram shows one retained route; it does not draw a collected nonbinding fraction.
operations.mechanism: CXXC-mediated affinity recognition of unmethylated CpG-containing DNA. Interpret the source label Hybridize as protein-DNA affinity binding, not nucleic-acid duplex formation.
operations.information_effect: Capture selects DNA fragments according to their unmethylated CpG content. The information carrier remains genomic DNA; capture does not establish promoter activity or make every retained site unmethylated.

operations.label: deep sequencing (CAP-seq)
operations.description: Generate DNA sequence reads from the library derived from the CAP-enriched DNA. This broad readout is named in the overall diagram title and supported by the primary paper; the drawing ends at a DNA icon and does not depict library-preparation internals or a sequencing instrument.
operations.mechanism: Illumina Solexa DNA sequencing in the associated primary implementation. Sequencing adaptors are reported on the input before CAP; no post-elution adaptor-ligation sequence is inferred from the diagram.
operations.information_effect: Reads retain genomic identity of captured fragments. With genomic mapping, read enrichment localizes recovered CpG-rich hypomethylated regions. Affinity enrichment alone does not determine the methylation status of each cytosine, and incomplete recovery can reflect capture efficiency.

Additional papers and recommended TruSeq kits do not expand the target scope.
